questions.question: Change 3 hours into minutes, 21 days into weeks and 100 minutes into hours and minutes.
questions.expected_answer: 3 hours is 3 times 60, which is 180 minutes. 21 days is 21 divided by 7, which is 3 weeks. 100 minutes is 60 plus 40, which is 1 hour 40 minutes.

questions.question: School starts at 07:45 and ends at 13:30. Find the length of the school day by counting on.
questions.expected_answer: 07:45 to 08:00 is 15 minutes, 08:00 to 13:00 is 5 hours, and 13:00 to 13:30 is 30 minutes. Total: 5 hours 45 minutes.

questions.question: A trip takes 3 hours 45 minutes, plus a 25 minute lunch stop. What is the total time? Explain what you do when the minutes pass 60.
questions.expected_answer: 45 plus 25 is 70 minutes, which is 1 hour 10 minutes. Add that to 3 hours to get 4 hours 10 minutes. When the minutes reach 60 or more, change 60 of them into 1 hour.
